CommunityApplications.Profile:
SMB Bulk Share Control adds a Settings -> User Utilities page for enabling or disabling SMB export across normal Unraid user shares in bulk, with safety features like security-mode preservation, exclusions for system shares, timestamped backups, restore, and an optional automatic mode. This repository contains the single SMB Bulk Share Control plugin.
Support and bug reports: https://github.com/RayMunro/unraid-smb-bulk-share/issues
